question: These numbered clips are shuffled segments from one cooking video. Determine their chronological order. Return only clip numbers joined by ->.

observed_information.statement: A blender containing chopped white ingredients is shown processing them into a coarse paste.
A glass bowl containing white strips coated in red spice flakes is mixed and receives a large dollop of white paste.
The bowl contents are vigorously mixed into a thick, uniform red paste.
Bok choy is cut on a dark cutting board and a cut piece is held by hand.
A bowl is shown containing red paste and green vegetables.
A large glass bowl containing red spicy paste mixed with green vegetables is shown fully packed into a white rectangular storage container.
A close-up shows green leafy vegetables and red paste inside a translucent plastic container.
A woman holds a plastic container with food, and the view then shows bok choy resting on paper towels.
Bok choy is shown resting on paper towels in blurry close-up and in-focus wide shots.

working_relations.statement: v2 shows formation of a uniform red paste, while v3 shows red paste together with green vegetables.
v3 and v1 both show a bowl containing red paste and green vegetables, with v1 also showing packing into a container.
v1 shows packed food in containers and v4 shows a woman holding a plastic container with food.
v4 shows bok choy resting on paper towels, while v3 shows bok choy being cut and later appearing in a mixed bowl.

unresolved_issues.issue: The identity of the container holding the packed food between v1 and v4 remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: v1 reports a white rectangular storage container and a translucent plastic container, while v4 reports only a plastic container with food without shape, material, or contents details.

unresolved_issues.issue: The chronological relationship between bok choy resting on paper towels in v4 and bok choy being cut or mixed in v3 remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: v4 shows resting bok choy without a transition to cutting or paste mixing, and v3 shows cutting and a mixed bowl without showing the paper-towel stage.

unresolved_issues.issue: The relationship between v2's paste-making stage and v3's bowl with red paste and green vegetables remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: v2 shows strips, flakes, and paste formation without green vegetables, while v3 shows green vegetables with paste without showing the strips or the mixing of paste into vegetables.

unresolved_issues.issue: Whether the bowl state shown in v3 is the same pre-packing bowl state shown at the start of v1 remains unresolved.
unresolved_issues.reason: v3 reports only the bowl with red paste and green vegetables, while v1 reports a similar bowl already being packed into a container without showing the transfer moment.

candidate_requests.observable: Compare the container shape, material, and visible food contents in v1-b0001-e1 and v1-b0001-e2 with the container held in v4-b0001-e1.
Compare whether the bok choy in v4-b0001-e1, v4-b0001-e2, and v4-b0001-e3 is whole, cut, wet, or already coated with paste relative to the bok choy in v3-b0001-e1 and v3-b0001-e2.
Compare the ingredient shape, color, paste texture, and vegetable presence between v2-b0001-e2, v2-b0001-e3, and v2-b0001-e4 and v3-b0001-e3 and v3-b0001-e4.
Compare the bowl contents, container position, and visible transfer cues between v3-b0001-e3, v3-b0001-e4, and v1-b0001-e1.
